lane_flags.en: Kit components are declared as parts. If the shipped set amounts to an essentially complete vehicle, customs may classify it as a CKD vehicle (8703 CKD lines, MITI AP needed). Not verified for this kit. (HS 8544.30.1200, 8708.29.9500, 8708.30.2900, 9401.20.1000)
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Obtain a written tariff classification ruling from Malaysian customs for the kit structure; keep kit content lists per container.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 就散件结构向马来西亚海关申请书面归类裁定；按柜保存散件装箱清单。
lane_flags.zh: 散件按零部件申报。若一批货物实质上构成基本完整的车辆，海关可能按 CKD 整车归类（8703 CKD 税目，并须 MITI AP）。本案例未经核实。（HS 8544.30.1200、8708.29.9500、8708.30.2900、9401.20.1000）

lane_flags.en: ACFTA preference claimed: each shipment needs a Form E issued before or at shipment, valid one year; origin evidence (RVC >= 40%) must be kept for verification.
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Collect cost breakdowns from suppliers; check Form E data against the invoice before departure.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 向供应商收集成本构成；离港前核对 Form E 与发票信息一致。
lane_flags.zh: 申请 ACFTA 优惠：每票须在装运前或装运时取得 Form E（有效期一年），并留存区域价值成分不低于 40% 的原产地证据以备核查。

lane_flags.en: HARN (8544.30.1200): supplier RVC 38% does not meet the 40% general rule and CTH is not met, so MFN 30% applies. Annual duty at stake: USD 684,000.
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Work with the supplier to document regional content (e.g. ASEAN or Chinese terminals and copper) before claiming; re-run the origin check.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 与供应商合作提升并记录区域价值成分（如采购中国或东盟产端子、铜材）后再申请优惠，并重新核算原产地。
lane_flags.zh: HARN（8544.30.1200）：供应商区域价值成分 38%，未达 40% 一般规则且不满足品目改变，适用最惠国税率 30%；每年涉及关税约 684,000 美元。

lane_flags.en: Sales tax on imported components is set to nil on the assumption that Customer A holds Schedule C (registered manufacturer) exemption; eligibility conditions were not verified. Without it, 10% sales tax applies on customs value plus duty.
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Confirm the Schedule C approval and its validity for each HS line before go-live.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 上线前确认附表 C 批文及其对各税号的有效性。
lane_flags.zh: 进口零部件销售税按 Customer A 已取得附表 C（注册制造商）豁免计为零；资格条件未经核实。若无此豁免，须按完税价格加关税的 10% 缴纳销售税。

lane_flags.en: The programme is an internal-combustion SUV, so the EV component duty exemption (until 31 Dec 2027) does not apply; an EV variant would need its own eligibility check.
lane_flags.zh: 本项目为燃油 SUV，不适用电动车零部件进口关税豁免（至 2027 年 12 月 31 日）；如推出电动车型需另行确认资格。

en: Recommended: Ocean FCL (40ft HC) at USD 286 per kit landed, P90 35.2 days, 93.1% on time against the 38-day target, risk score 56/100.
It meets the 90.0% on-time requirement and has the best weighted score of cost, P90 time and risk among the options that do.
Sensitivity: with a 30-day target the same option would be on time 78.5% of the time.
Ocean LCL is dominated by Ocean FCL (40ft HC) (no better on cost, P90 or risk).
Alternative on the Pareto front: Air freight - 488% more per kit, P90 7.0 days (-28.2), risk 47; on time 100.0%.

Conditions to manage: [MY-KIT-CLASSIFICATION] Kit components are declared as parts. If the shipped set amounts to an essentially complete vehicle, customs may classify it as a CKD vehicle (8703 CKD lines, MITI AP needed). Not verified for this kit. (HS 8544.30.1200, 8708.29.9500, 8708.30.2900, 9401.20.1000) [FTA-ACFTA-FORM-E] ACFTA preference claimed: each shipment needs a Form E issued before or at shipment, valid one year; origin evidence (RVC >= 40%) must be kept for verification. [FTA-ORIGIN-NOT-MET] HARN (8544.30.1200): supplier RVC 38% does not meet the 40% general rule and CTH is not met, so MFN 30% applies. Annual duty at stake: USD 684,000. [MY-SCHEDULE-C] Sales tax on imported components is set to nil on the assumption that Customer A holds Schedule C (registered manufacturer) exemption; eligibility conditions were not verified. Without it, 10% sales tax applies on customs value plus duty.
zh: 推荐方案：海运整箱（40 尺高柜）。每套落地成本 286 美元，P90 时效 35.2 天，38 天内送达概率 93.1%，风险评分 56/100。
该方案满足 90.0% 准时率要求，并在满足要求的方案中成本、P90 时效与风险的加权得分最优。
敏感性：若时效目标收紧至 30 天，该方案准时率为 78.5%。
海运拼箱在成本、P90 时效和风险上均不优于海运整箱（40 尺高柜），属被占优方案。
帕累托前沿上的备选：空运——每套成本高 488%，P90 7.0 天（少 28.2 天），风险 47；准时率 100.0%。

需重点管控：【MY-KIT-CLASSIFICATION】散件按零部件申报。若一批货物实质上构成基本完整的车辆，海关可能按 CKD 整车归类（8703 CKD 税目，并须 MITI AP）。本案例未经核实。（HS 8544.30.1200、8708.29.9500、8708.30.2900、9401.20.1000） 【FTA-ACFTA-FORM-E】申请 ACFTA 优惠：每票须在装运前或装运时取得 Form E（有效期一年），并留存区域价值成分不低于 40% 的原产地证据以备核查。 【FTA-ORIGIN-NOT-MET】HARN（8544.30.1200）：供应商区域价值成分 38%，未达 40% 一般规则且不满足品目改变，适用最惠国税率 30%；每年涉及关税约 684,000 美元。 【MY-SCHEDULE-C】进口零部件销售税按 Customer A 已取得附表 C（注册制造商）豁免计为零；资格条件未经核实。若无此豁免，须按完税价格加关税的 10% 缴纳销售税。

lane_flags.en: Sales tax on imported components is set to nil on the assumption that Customer A holds Schedule C (registered manufacturer) exemption; eligibility conditions were not verified. Without it, 10% sales tax applies on customs value plus duty.

lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 上线前确认附表 C 批文及其对各税号的有效性。

en: Recommended: Rail-sea via Qinzhou (FCL) at USD 80.84 per kit landed, P90 36.0 days, 92.4% on time against the 38-day target, risk score 62/100.
It meets the 90.0% on-time requirement and has the best weighted score of cost, P90 time and risk among the options that do.
Sensitivity: with a 30-day target the same option would be on time 76.8% of the time.
Alternative on the Pareto front: Air freight - 882% more per kit, P90 7.3 days (-28.8), risk 47; on time 100.0%.

Not offered: rail - No verified scheduled cross-border rail service for this lane: First run 2024; no current official timetable found. Re-enable by setting status: verified once a scheduled departure is confirmed..

Conditions to manage: [MY-KIT-CLASSIFICATION] Kit components are declared as parts. If the shipped set amounts to an essentially complete vehicle, customs may classify it as a CKD vehicle (8703 CKD lines, MITI AP needed). Not verified for this kit. (HS 8708.40.2600, 8708.80.1600) [FTA-ACFTA-FORM-E] ACFTA preference claimed: each shipment needs a Form E issued before or at shipment, valid one year; origin evidence (RVC >= 40%) must be kept for verification. [THIRD-COUNTRY-INVOICE] Goods ship China to Malaysia but are invoiced by an entity in SG: ACFTA Form E must show the third-party invoice number in Box 10 with that invoice attached (exporter and consignee in Parties); under RCEP tick Box 17 and name the invoicing company in Box 14. Customs value follows the sale for export to Malaysia (which sale applies in a chain was not verified). [MY-SCHEDULE-C] Sales tax on imported components is set to nil on the assumption that Customer A holds Schedule C (registered manufacturer) exemption; eligibility conditions were not verified. Without it, 10% sales tax applies on customs value plus duty.
zh: 推荐方案：经钦州铁海联运（整箱）。每套落地成本 80.84 美元，P90 时效 36.0 天，38 天内送达概率 92.4%，风险评分 62/100。
该方案满足 90.0% 准时率要求，并在满足要求的方案中成本、P90 时效与风险的加权得分最优。
敏感性：若时效目标收紧至 30 天，该方案准时率为 76.8%。
帕累托前沿上的备选：空运——每套成本高 882%，P90 7.3 天（少 28.8 天），风险 47；准时率 100.0%。
未纳入：rail——该线路无经核实的定期跨境铁路班列，暂不纳入方案。。

需重点管控：【MY-KIT-CLASSIFICATION】散件按零部件申报。若一批货物实质上构成基本完整的车辆，海关可能按 CKD 整车归类（8703 CKD 税目，并须 MITI AP）。本案例未经核实。（HS 8708.40.2600、8708.80.1600） 【FTA-ACFTA-FORM-E】申请 ACFTA 优惠：每票须在装运前或装运时取得 Form E（有效期一年），并留存区域价值成分不低于 40% 的原产地证据以备核查。 【THIRD-COUNTRY-INVOICE】货物由中国直运马来西亚、由 SG 主体开票：ACFTA Form E 第 10 栏须填第三方发票号并随附该发票（出口商与收货人须在成员方境内）；RCEP 证书须勾选第 17 栏并在第 14 栏填写开票公司。完税价格以向马来西亚出口的销售为准（多环节销售中适用哪一环节未经核实）。 【MY-SCHEDULE-C】进口零部件销售税按 Customer A 已取得附表 C（注册制造商）豁免计为零；资格条件未经核实。若无此豁免，须按完税价格加关税的 10% 缴纳销售税。
